## Description

Provide a summary of the change, issue fixed, or feature added.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Adapter update (API changes on supported chat platforms)
- [ ] Performance / Security improvement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have verified syntax with `npm run lint`
- [ ] I have run all automated tests with `npm test`
- [ ] My changes pass on all 6 supported platforms without regression
- [ ] I have updated docs and `CHANGELOG.md` where appropriate
